summary: Iteration 47 — Phase MKT.1 (Demo Venue Seed + Merchant Marketplace goal-first + Branded Trivia campaigns + Admin Rate Card Matrix + Featured Coupon bidding) tested end-to-end on backend + mobile + web. Backend pytest test_iter47_mkt1.py: 25/25 PASS. Regression: test_iter45_rwd4.py + test_iter46_rwd5.py = 32/32 PASS. Backend coverage: (1) GET /api/merchant/my-businesses returns biz_demo_marketplace for demo user (auto-seeded on boot with owner_user_id=demo user_id). (2) GET /api/merchant/marketplace/goals returns 4 goals, campaign_types {coupon_bid, trivia}, and rate_card_hints with pricing_model/base_cents/min_cents/max_cents for both types; requires auth (401 without token). (3) POST /api/merchant/marketplace/campaigns: foreign merchant_id → 404 merchant_not_found; coupon_bid with bid_cents=0 → 400 bid_required; trivia with empty questions → 400 questions_required; valid coupon_bid + trivia both created OK with owner_user_id=demo user_id, status='active', sponsor_name populated from businesses.name ('The Grind Coffee (Demo)'). (4) GET /api/merchant/marketplace/campaigns lists only caller's own (all rows carry owner_user_id=demo). (5) POST /campaigns/{id}/pause + /activate: owner 200 with correct status; unknown id 404 campaign_not_found; non-owner (demo trying to pause an admin-created campaign) 403 not_owner. (6) GET /api/brand-trivia/active returns active/budget-remaining trivia with answer_index STRIPPED from client payload and per-question 'answered' flag; POST /brand-trivia/{id}/answer awards reward_points on correct (15pts verified), returns correct=false/awarded=0 on wrong, 409 already_answered on retry (unique index on user_id+campaign_id+question_index). (7) GET /api/brand-coupons/featured sorted by bid_cents desc; POST /brand-coupons/{id}/claim awards reward_points_on_claim (10pts) and 409 on retry. (8) GET /api/admin/rate-card returns 7 seeded items (display_banner, audio_preroll, sponsored_rj, push_notification, coupon_featured, trivia_sponsored, video_ad); PUT rejects bad pricing_model with 400 bad_pricing_model, rejects min>max with 400 min_gt_max, otherwise persists (verified round-trip on coupon_featured.base_cents); non-admin gets 403. Mobile (Expo web preview, viewport 390×844, demo bearer): /merchant/marketplace goal-first flow verified end-to-end — marketplace-root + mkt-start → mkt-goal-more_customers → mkt-type-coupon_bid → mkt-venue-biz_demo_marketplace → mkt-title/mkt-bid/mkt-budget/mkt-launch → back to list with new mkt-toggle-* (count went from 4 to 5). /brand-trivia reachable via /earn's earn-brand-trivia link; brand-trivia-root renders 2 bt-campaign-* rows with 7 bt-choice-* buttons; tapping a choice fires the answer API. Profile menu-merchant-marketplace + menu-merchant-bonuses both present. Web admin (viewport 1440×900, admin cookie): /admin/rate-card renders rate-card-table + 7 rate-row-* + rate-card-save; clicking Save persists and shows 'Rate card saved' toast; sidebar adnav-ads-rate-card link visible under Ad Monetization. Regression /merchant/bonuses + /earn overview still work.

critical_code_review_comments: merchant_marketplace.claim_featured_coupon: charges cost_usd = bid_cents/100 but does NOT decrement any advertiser wallet — spent_usd only tracks against campaign budget_usd. If merchants pre-fund via advertisers_v2 wallet elsewhere, this route bypasses that ledger. Confirm the intended billing path (campaign budget only vs advertiser wallet).

merchant_marketplace.brand_trivia_answer: cost_usd for trivia is HARDCODED to rate.base_cents (line 346) rather than a per-campaign bid — merchants have no control over spend velocity per correct answer. Consider a campaign-level bid_cents override for parity with coupon_bid.

merchant_marketplace._owned_campaign returns 403 with body {code:'not_owner'} but ad4_coupon_campaigns._assert_merchant_owner uses {code:'not_merchant_owner_or_staff'} — inconsistent codes across the same package. Standardize.

merchant_marketplace.create_campaign: budget_usd is stored as float but spent_usd is round(..., 4) — floating-point drift over many claims could cause budget to be exceeded by fractions of a cent before auto-pause. Consider storing cents as ints (budget_cents, spent_cents) like the rate card.

merchant_marketplace.seed_marketplace uses `demo.get('market') or 'Dallas'` as the demo venue city — fine for now, but couples the demo venue to whichever market the demo user lands in. If a future test seeds demo into 'Dubai' the biz row will move city, potentially breaking city-filtered discovery tests.

merchant_marketplace: no rate-limit / anti-abuse on POST /brand-coupons/{id}/claim — a scripted client can claim every active coupon in one burst since the only guard is per-user idempotency. Consider a per-user global claim-throttle window.
